description: This file defines the XFontSource class, which represents a font file in memory within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for creating font sources from files, byte arrays, and various platform-specific font objects, and manages font metadata and cache references.

classes.name: XFontSource
classes.description: Represents a font file in memory, supporting creation from files, byte arrays, and platform-specific font objects. Manages font metadata and caching.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFrom
methods.description: Gets an existing font source or creates a new one from a byte array, utilizing caching.

methods.name: CreateFromFile
methods.description: Creates an XFontSource instance from a font file specified by its path.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromGlyphTypeface
methods.description: Platform-specific method to create font sources from glyph typeface objects (not implemented for CORE).

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromGdi
methods.description: Creates a font source from a GDI font object, reading its font data via GDI APIs.

methods.name: ReadFontBytesFromGdi
methods.description: Helper function to extract font bytes from a GDI font object by accessing font data via GDI handles.

methods.name: GetOrCreateFromWpf
methods.description: Creates a font source from a WPF GlyphTypeface object.

methods.name: ReadFontBytesFromWpf
methods.description: Extracts font bytes from a WPF font stream.

methods.name: CreateCompiledFont
methods.description: Creates a font source directly from a byte array, intended for pre-compiled fonts.

methods.name: FontFace
methods.description: Property for getting or setting the OpenType font face related to this font source.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Returns a unique checksum associated with the font data.

methods.name: FontName
methods.description: Returns the font's name from its name table.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.description: Byte array containing the font file data.
